raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-NGA-AgroProcessingLivelihood",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Macroeconomic downturn and oil price shock reduce federal and state fiscal capacity, threatening timely disbursement of credit proceeds.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement performance‑based tranche releases and maintain a contingency reserve; secure supplementary counterpart funding from the federal budget where possible.",
      "evidence": "Country Context – oil price shock caused GDP contraction and fiscal strain (Section 1.1)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Delayed establishment or staffing of State Coordination Offices (SCOs) slows project roll‑out in new participating states.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Set firm milestones for SCO establishment, use accelerated recruitment, and assign experienced NCO staff to mentor new offices.",
      "evidence": "Implementation Arrangements – new SCOs to be created in Kogi and additional states (Section IV.1)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Insufficient procurement capacity at state level leads to non‑compliant contracts and value‑for‑money losses.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Hire a procurement consultant to train and mentor state procurement officers; adopt standardized bidding documents and conduct joint reviews with NCO.",
      "evidence": "Procurement – low procurement capacity in many states; need for capacity building (Section IV.4)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Financial management weaknesses (unretired advances, inadequate documentation) could cause misappropriation of funds.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement the enhanced accountability framework, use computerized accounting, and conduct quarterly internal audits per the Financial Procedures Manual.",
      "evidence": "Financial Management – key issues of unretired advances and inadequate documentation (Section III.3)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Low adoption of improved climate‑smart technologies by farmers reduces expected productivity gains.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide intensive extension services, farmer field schools, and conditional matching grants tied to technology use.",
      "evidence": "Component 1 – technology demonstration and adoption sub‑components aim to stimulate uptake (Section III.1.2‑1.3)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Fluctuating market prices may lower revenue streams, undermining the financial viability of value‑chain enterprises.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop market information platforms, price risk‑management tools, and diversify target value chains to spread price risk.",
      "evidence": "Sensitivity analysis – 20% reduction in benefits makes NPV negative (Section VII.8)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Inadequate coordination among multiple steering committees (NSC, SSC, STC) can cause decision delays and overlaps.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Define clear terms of reference, schedule regular joint meetings, and appoint a secretariat in NCO to track decisions.",
      "evidence": "Implementation Arrangements – oversight bodies at federal and state levels (Section IV.1‑4)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Political changes or policy reversals could affect commitment to the Agriculture Promotion Policy and project support.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Anchor project activities in legally binding subsidiary agreements and align with multiyear state development plans.",
      "evidence": "Project Development Objective – alignment with APP and requirement for subsidiary agreements (Section III.2)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Use of fertilizers and pesticides may contaminate soil and water, leading to environmental non‑compliance.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce Integrated Pest Management Plan, conduct regular ESMP monitoring, and train farmers on safe input handling.",
      "evidence": "Environmental – potential contamination from chemical inputs (Section VI.99‑100)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Construction of roads, jetties, and small dams may encroach on sensitive natural habitats, attracting regulatory penalties.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Perform site screenings, follow ESMF chance‑find procedures, and avoid ecologically sensitive zones during design.",
      "evidence": "Environmental – natural habitats safeguard and need to avoid incursion (Section VI.100‑a)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Land acquisition for aggregation centres could trigger involuntary resettlement disputes.",
      "category": "social",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prepare Resettlement Action Plans per the RPF, ensure fair compensation, and engage affected communities early.",
      "evidence": "Involuntary Resettlement – RPF prepared to address land requisition (Section VI.d)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Gender gaps may limit women’s ability to access grants and technology, reducing project’s equity outcomes.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set minimum 50% female participation in sub‑component 2.1, provide gender‑sensitive training, and monitor through gender tracker.",
      "evidence": "Component 2 – women and youth empowerment sub‑component targets 50% women (Section III.15‑18)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Security challenges in North East and Niger Delta may disrupt field activities and supply chains.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Coordinate with security agencies, schedule activities in safer windows, and develop contingency logistics plans.",
      "evidence": "Country Context – stabilization measures focus on security in North East and Niger Delta (Section I.5)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Delays in beneficiary selection and grant disbursement could demotivate farmer groups and stall business alliances.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Standardize grant application timelines, use a third‑party service provider for rapid assessment, and publish clear criteria.",
      "evidence": "Grants operational mechanism – need for transparent, timely grant processing (Section III.4.ii)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Insufficient monitoring and data quality may compromise M&E reporting and impact evaluation.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy the MIS with automated data capture, train M&E officers, and conduct periodic data quality audits.",
      "evidence": "Results Monitoring – MIS to collect, organize, analyze data (Section IV.2)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Cost overruns on infrastructure works (roads, jetties) could exhaust the US$40 m allocated for Component 3.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply strict cost controls, use independent engineering supervision, and include contingency buffers in design budgets.",
      "evidence": "Component 3 – infrastructure sub‑components cost US$40 m (Section III.3)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Low private‑sector investment may limit the scaling‑up of business alliances and out‑grower schemes.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Engage private investors early through the Business Alliance model, provide risk‑share mechanisms, and showcase pilot successes.",
      "evidence": "Component 1 – business alliances link farmers with off‑takers to crowd‑in private investment (Section III.1)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Changes in export tariffs or trade policy could affect profitability of export‑oriented value chains (cocoa, cashew).",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Monitor trade policy developments, diversify target markets, and incorporate tariff‑risk clauses in contracts.",
      "evidence": "High‑level objectives – value chains include export‑potential crops (Section III.1)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Inadequate O&M arrangements for newly built infrastructure may lead to rapid degradation and loss of benefits.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Require beneficiaries to submit O&M plans, provide technical assistance for maintenance, and link costs to grant conditions.",
      "evidence": "Component 3 – O&M arrangements to be defined before investment (Section III.3)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "High staff turnover or failure to recruit qualified personnel could weaken project implementation capacity.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Offer competitive two‑year contracts, tie retention bonuses to performance evaluations, and maintain a pool of seconded experts.",
      "evidence": "Staffing – contracts for two years with performance‑based renewal (Section IV.13)"
    }
  ]
}
